item.title: Building calmer reserving workflows
item.description:
Reserving is already hard. The goal of tooling should be to make the work calmer: fewer manual steps, fewer hidden assumptions, and fewer surprises at the end of the quarter.

What I optimize for

  • Reproducibility over heroics.
  • Clear inputs and traceable assumptions.
  • Small scripts that compose, not one giant platform.

A simple loop

  1. Ingest data.
  2. Validate aggressively.
  3. Compute and explain.
  4. Ship a narrative, not just numbers.

More soon.

item.title: A field guide to model reduction in insurance
item.description:
Model reduction is a way to keep the shape of a complex system while throwing away most of its computational cost.

In insurance, that mindset shows up as:

  • Precomputing what can be precomputed.
  • Using approximations with explicit error checks.
  • Building workflows where the fast path is the default.

Practical takeaway

If you can write down what changes and what stays fixed, you can often build a reduced representation that is both faster and easier to explain.
